sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: You have got to be kidding me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exasperated and incredulous, with a burst of frustrated panic at how unfairly her already-bad morning is going.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... move already.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is impatient and stressed, urgently frustrated by the delay and mentally pushing the crowd to clear so she can recover from being late.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. It's fine. New term, fresh start, and I'm sweating before homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to talk herself into staying upbeat, but underneath the joking words she feels flustered, stressed, and embarrassed about already being in a mess on the first day.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and breathless from being late, but pushing forward with determined, apologetic urgency as she tries to force her way through the crowd.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless, relieved, and a little triumphant at having barely arrived in time, with her earlier panic easing into upbeat determination.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She freezes in sudden embarrassment and awkward realization, her confidence collapsing for a beat as she registers that she has burst into the wrong room.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels abruptly embarrassed and flustered, with a nervous attempt to recover her composure by checking whether she has simply walked into the wrong classroom.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Right! Great! Love that for me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s mortified and embarrassed by the mistake, but is forcing a bright, joking front to recover her composure and keep from looking flustered.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from barging into the wrong classroom, but is trying to recover with upbeat, socially smooth energy and a forced confidence.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously? You may have just saved my life.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels intensely relieved and grateful, with a burst of embarrassed humor as she tries to shake off the morning’s chaos by joking warmly at Mika.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Here! Present. Very present. Extremely sorry.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and embarrassed from the chaotic morning, but trying to recover with upbeat, self-aware humor and a determined effort to make a good impression.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: I can't believe that happened before nine in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and overwhelmed by how disastrously the morning started, but is also trying to laugh it off with relieved, self-deprecating energy.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Recovered? I entered the wrong class like I was making a dramatic entrance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s embarrassed but laughing it off with self-deprecating humor, trying to turn a mortifying mistake into something playful and confident.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Then I'll call it confidence and not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s joking herself back into composure, turning embarrassment into playful self-assurance and trying to frame the whole mess as a funny win rather than a humiliating mistake.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Hey, since I already embarrassed myself in front of half the first years... want to stick together at lunch?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sheepish about her earlier blunders but is now relaxed, grateful, and warmly hopeful that turning the awkward morning into a new friendship will make the day better.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful
